changes: 逐候选校验隔离，非法候选不再丢弃后续合法主张
writer视图共享完整重复条件，按操作及对象选择原始观察，事实与来源身份保持
分类背景与实际前提分开，保留登录、邀请、跨主体先授权及父级访问等已审核反例
真缺产品维度时生成有审核的短局部报告，汇总缺口并保留采集阻断
软件未知能力轴保留，硬件不生成无关软件空表

frontend.scope: frontend files identical between v9 tests/build and final v10 source manifest

secret_scan.scope: literal current configured credentials in nonignored text sources/docs/eval, built frontend and specified acceptance artifacts; excludes secret env bodies and Git history

notion_original_response.scope: parsing only; no new model review or publication

offline_fixed_inputs.old_structured_binding_policy: old mismatches remain rejected; re-extraction uses new fact/binding identities and is only an offline diagnostic

hardware.scope: real writer entry with exact-quote and review fixtures; not live semantic validation; original formal report length 21105 is not the comparison base

limitations: 条件解析是有限规则并保留原文语义审核，不能宣称任意自然语言条件都已解决
候选覆盖不是已审核发布覆盖或独立人工事实准确率
历史错误报告未自动迁移为新审核版本
短稿部分audit.gaps保留在审计记录中，不逐条展开在正文
本机Qdrant local验证不覆盖HTTP Qdrant、Temporal、Redis多worker或实机Postgres RLS
健康检查仍报告既有Temporal切流策略问题
